description: This file defines the I18NTranslation entity class for a Human Resource Management system. It models translation entries, including language, text value, modification time, and related language string. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes traits for date handling and decorator support.

classes.name: I18NTranslation
classes.description: Entity class representing a translation entry with references to language string and language, along with translation value, modification timestamp, and customized flag.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the translation entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the translation entry.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Returns the associated language string object.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Associates a language string object with this translation.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language object for this translation.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Associates a language object with this translation.

methods.name: isCustomized
methods.description: Checks whether the translation has been customized.

methods.name: setCustomized
methods.description: Marks the translation as customized or not.

methods.name: getModifiedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last modification.
